evidence.text: Review Witten's bubble by double Wick rotation of five-dimensional Schwarzschild geometry. Smooth closure of the circle fixes its coordinate periodicity, and the resulting tip contains a dS₃ bubble worldvolume and a cigar-shaped transverse disk.

sources.title: Decay of flux vacua to nothing

evidence.text: Dimensional reduction over the magnetized S² produces a four-dimensional canonical radion ψ and effective potential. Its extrema distinguish stable compactifications from unstable branches that can roll toward another extremum or decompactification.

sources.title: New Kaluza-Klein instantons and the decay of AdS vacua

evidence.text: Experimentally discovered algebraic relations between g, h and ξ reduce the remaining system to an autonomous third-order equation for g, whose order can be lowered by one. The authors then integrate numerically; the relations' deeper origin is left open.

sources.title: Decay of Kaluza-Klein vacuum via singular instanton

evidence.text: An ADM decomposition provides another calculation of the exterior action. Thermodynamic analysis uses ADM energy and entropy from a microcanonical Legendre transformation, then reconstructs the exponent through B=(E−TS)/T.

sources.title: Much ado about nothing

evidence.text: Boundary stress tensors, extrinsic curvature and AdS counterterms are used to compute masses and finite on-shell actions; asymptotic falloffs encode the charges that tunneling must preserve.

sources.title: Bubbles of Nothing in Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Reduce the coupled Einstein–scalar equations to radial equations, determine exact asymptotic data, and integrate outward using a near-core expansion. For n=1 the shooting parameters are ℓ and the leading scalar slope f′₀; Euclidean actions are obtained by background subtraction.

sources.title: Neutralizing topological obstructions to bubbles of nothing

evidence.text: Use curvature-dominated small-ξ initial conditions and shoot in the bubble-size parameter η; determine the brane position from junction consistency, switch on the exterior flux potential, and match the Minkowski asymptotics. Dimensionless solutions give Stot=(Mp⁴/U0)S̄.

sources.title: Bubbles of Nothing and Supersymmetric Compactifications

evidence.text: Smooth solutions are obtained from coupled matter and Einstein ODEs using multiple shooting and Newton's method. Near-core Taylor expansions determine regular initial data; linearized WKB matter tails and vacuum matching provide finite-radius approximations to asymptotic boundary conditions.

sources.title: Bubbles of Nothing and Supersymmetric Compactifications

evidence.text: A double Wick rotation of Schwarzschild supplies the vacuum bubble geometry. Dressing its tip with a Nambu–Goto string gives the thin-wall estimate 2H0^-1 = R/(1 − 4Gμ), at fixed asymptotic R. The vacuum relation B′ = H0C/R serves as a geometric diagnostic.

sources.title: Neutralizing topological obstructions to bubbles of nothing

evidence.text: For the Dirac spectrum, conformally separate the S³ factor, expand in sphere eigenspinors, and solve coupled radial equations by shooting on a finite interval. Wall regularity and self-adjoint boundary conditions define the numerical problem.

sources.title: De Sitter decays to infinity

sources.title: Tunneling potentials to nothing

evidence.text: Numerically integrate Vt from low field rather than using large-field overshoot/undershoot shooting. Minkowski/AdS solutions require an additional family parameter beyond their false-vacuum value and zero slope; dS families can instead be labeled by the departure point ϕi.

sources.title: Bubbles of nothing: the tunneling potential approach

evidence.text: Use S[Vt]=(6π²/κ²)∫dϕ (D+Vt′)²/(Vt²D), with D²=Vt′²+6κ(V−Vt)Vt, and solve its second-order Euler–Lagrange equation. The Euclidean dictionary reconstructs the field and metric profiles from Vt.
